### Line 264

**Source:** [stdlib/geometry/brep.library.plato, line 264](../../../../../stdlib/geometry/brep.library.plato#L264).

```plato

    //==
    // # BREP tessellation
    //
    // The exact-to-discrete seam for BREP shells: sampling each face's surface
    // over the full unit UV square into an indexed triangle mesh. Like the C#
    // sketch it ports, v1 tessellates the FULL UV grid and ignores loop clipping
    // — exact for the faceted Planar / Bilinear cases whose loops span the whole
    // patch (Box does), approximate once trimming loops arrive. Triangles wind
    // counter-clockwise seen from outside when the surface follows the outward
    // du x dv convention (brep.types.plato).

    // One triangle of a full-grid tessellation over a cols x cols vertex
    // lattice (cols = resolution + 1): triangles 2*cell and 2*cell + 1 split
    // grid cell `k / 2` along its low-UV-to-high-UV diagonal.
    GridTriangleFace(k: Integer, cols: Integer): TriangleFace
    {
        var cell = k / 2;
        var col = cell % (cols - 1);
        var row = cell / (cols - 1);
        var a = row * cols + col;
        var b = a + 1;
        var c = a + cols + 1;
        var d = a + cols;
        return k % 2 == 0
            ? (VertexIndex(a), VertexIndex(b), VertexIndex(c))
            : (VertexIndex(a), VertexIndex(c), VertexIndex(d));
    }
```
